subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for multi-agent completion isolation?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-backed, but the remaining solution boundary spans session ownership, subagent delivery guarantees, fallback-lane behavior, and possible isolation semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep #43367 open, review focused PRs such as #86540 individually, and close the umbrella only after linked session-lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or deliberately split.

options.title: Promote Isolation Design
options.body: Make #96975 the canonical product direction and explicitly map the remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Create or select one canonical issue per root cause and close this umbrella only after every production-evidence thread is linked to its owner.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep #43367 open, review focused PRs such as #86540 individually, and close the umbrella only after linked session-lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or deliberately split.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product and architecture boundary choice, and the available VISION evidence points to steipete as the best routing owner.
